name: Rune Revenant
definitionRules: Summon a 18 HP / 4 Power Thrall. Attacks strike twice.
rules: Summon Rune Revenant: 18 HP / 4 Power. Attacks strike twice. Rot starts at 1. Automatically spend Corpses equal to its Mana cost instead if available.
displayRules:
Summon a Thrall. 18 HP / 4 Power.
Attacks strike twice.
Rot starts at 1.
If you have 2 Corpses, spend them instead of Mana.
